courses.title: Module 1 — Sets & Inequalities
courses.description: Set theory, operations, Venn counting, and linear, quadratic, absolute-value and rational inequalities.

courses.title: Module 2 — Functions
courses.description: Domain, range, parity, inverse and composite functions, exponentials, logarithms, sequences and trigonometric functions.

courses.title: Module 3 — Geometry & Trigonometry
courses.description: Lines, circles, conics, trigonometry, vectors, complex numbers and solid geometry.

courses.title: Module 4 — Calculus & Statistics
courses.description: Limits, derivatives, integrals, counting, probability and statistics.

courses.title: Module 1 — Mechanics
courses.description: Kinematics, Newton's laws, work and energy, momentum, circular motion and gravitation.

courses.title: Module 2 — Thermodynamics
courses.description: Heat, calorimetry, ideal gases, the laws of thermodynamics and kinetic theory.

courses.title: Module 3 — Electromagnetism
courses.description: Electrostatics, circuits, magnetism, induction and AC.

courses.title: Module 4 — Optics & Waves
courses.description: Reflection, refraction, lenses, interference, diffraction, standing waves and oscillations.

courses.title: Module 5 — Modern Physics
courses.description: Photoelectric effect, atomic models, radioactivity and nuclear energy.

courses.title: Module 1 — Atomic Structure
courses.description: Atoms, isotopes, electron configuration, the periodic table, bonding and the mole.

courses.title: Module 2 — Chemical Reactions
courses.description: Equations, acids and bases, energetics, rates, equilibrium, electrolysis and redox.

courses.title: Module 3 — Organic Chemistry
courses.description: Hydrocarbons, alcohols, acids, polymers, isomers and reaction types.

courses.title: Module 4 — Inorganic Chemistry
courses.description: Bonding and structure, quantitative chemistry, thermochemistry, electrochemistry and the main elements.

courses.title: Module 5 — Experiments & Applications
courses.description: Laboratory technique, gas preparation, separation, ion tests and industrial processes.
